mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (<=0.1%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Federal Reserve Policy Response to Pandemic
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is <=0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 10.0% signals deepening recessionary pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0, or the correlation coefficient between UNRATE and returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 258.0) signals imminent policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term in a regression has a non-negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods within the post-pandemic recovery regime when HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the correlation between demand indicators and returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above the 2017 base level (INDPRO > 100.0) signals expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200.0 (thousands of units) indicates robust residential construction, which is a leading indicator of strong consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the labor market recovery regime, nonfarm payrolls above 139,000 (thousands) signal strengthening employment conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods within the labor market recovery regime when PAYEMS > 139000, or the correlation is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 500,000 (millions of dollars) indicates strong consumer spending, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.
